originals.ko: 나는 네가 그걸 아주 잘한다고 생각해
originals.why: Natural North Welsh. bo' ti'n is used as 'that you (are)', the sense this course teaches. hi = the language.
Natural; same sense of bo' ti'n.

originals.ko: 나는 네가 그걸 아주 잘한다고 생각한다고 말하고 싶어
originals.why: Grammatical and idiomatic: two nested bo' clauses. The Korean leaves out the second 내가, as natural Korean does when the subject is the same. 생각한다고 still forces bo' fi'n meddwl.
Open-ended BUILD fragment. The ~ mirrors the open end after siarad.
oeddat ti'n meddwl bo' ti'n … ('you thought you were …') is natural North Welsh. bo' ti'n keeps its taught sense. The open end is mirrored with ~.

originals.ko: 나는 네가 아주 잘하고 있다고 생각해
originals.why: This is the seed sentence itself. Natural, and the LEGO is used in its taught sense.

originals.ko: 나는 네가 웨일스어를 아주 잘한다고 생각해
originals.why: Natural. The habitual 한다고 (siarad) is kept apart from the progressive 잘하고 있다고 (gwneud).

originals.ko: 나는 네가 흥미로운 무언가를 하고 있다고 생각해
originals.why: Natural; LEGO used in its taught sense.

originals.ko: 나는 네가 말을 아주 잘한다고 말하고 싶었어
originals.why: Natural. 말을 …한다 renders siarad without an object, which keeps it apart from deud (말하다) and gwneud (잘하고 있다).

originals.ko: 나는 네가 웨일스어를 조금 한다고 생각해
originals.why: Natural; LEGO used in its taught sense.
